brief.concept: The definitive pinned YouTube introduction to Propeller Picks: an in-depth walkthrough of the free Analyzer and full research workspace, confidence and agent evidence, desktop and mobile flow, public historical record, methodology, limitations, and responsible use.
brief.primary_question: What is Propeller Picks, how does its research workflow work on desktop and mobile, and what should a new user understand before relying on a model signal?
brief.audience: Prospective and new Propeller Picks users arriving from the channel home page, search, or a shared video.
brief.learning_outcome: Viewers can explain the distinct jobs of Propeller's sport-specific analysis agents, use the free Analyzer responsibly, distinguish directional confidence from probability, understand current MLB hitter fantasy projections, and interpret the public historical archive without mistaking it for a guarantee or forward-tested ROI.
brief.cta: Start with the free Prop Analyzer at https://propellerpicks.com/analyzer/, then open the web app when you want the full research workspace.
brief.freshness_requirements: Capture the current public Analyzer, current desktop and mobile research UI, and current Results page shortly before render. Historical figures must carry date, unit, and non-ROI limitation; never present repeated or retrospective archive rows as uniquely published future recommendations.

Methodology: player, market, line, game context, team environment, recent usage, agent categories, directional confidence, and forward-record contract; checked July 22, 2026.

Current public historical archive and limitations: 2,185,007 raw historical analysis rows and 293,020 collapsed public-ledger entries; not a uniquely published forward-test or ROI record; checked July 22, 2026.
Forward record methodology: published before verified event start, exact price, and settlement contract.
Current MLB hitter fantasy projection method: current market components, recent-form completion, DraftKings MLB scoring, and range limitations.

Current public fantasy scope and explicit exclusions: MLB hitters only; floor, point projection, ceiling; no pitchers, other sports, salary optimization, lineup optimization, entry submission, or guarantees.
